يغتصبن (form VIII)
# يَغْتَصِبْنَ (yaḡtaṣibna) /jaɣ.ta.sˤib.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# يُغْتَصَبْنَ (yuḡtaṣabna) /juɣ.ta.sˤab.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
